description: Add translation keys to locales/en.default.json and create the countdown timer snippet at snippets/announcement-countdown.liquid
steps: Read locales/en.default.json and add a new 'sections' top-level key (or add to existing) with 'premium_announcement' sub-object containing translation keys: 'days', 'hours', 'minutes', 'seconds', 'previous', 'next', 'close', 'pause', 'play', 'announcement_bar' (aria label). The file uses JSONC format (comments are allowed). Add the new keys before the closing brace of the root object.

Create snippets/announcement-countdown.liquid - a Liquid snippet that receives 'end_date' as a variable and renders countdown timer markup with spans for days, hours, minutes, seconds. Use translation keys via {{ 'sections.premium_announcement.days' | t }} pattern. Include data-countdown-end attribute with ISO date string for JS to parse.
acceptance_criteria: locales/en.default.json is valid JSON (ignoring comments) and contains sections.premium_announcement keys
snippets/announcement-countdown.liquid exists and renders countdown HTML with data-countdown-end attribute
Countdown snippet uses t filter for labels (days, hours, minutes, seconds)
verification: python3 -c "import json,re; content=open('/projects/sandbox/new1/locales/en.default.json').read(); clean=re.sub(r'//[^\n]*','',content); json.loads(clean); print('en.default.json is valid')"
findings: The verification command for JSON validation needs to handle multi-line comments (/* ... */) in addition to single-line comments (//). Use re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', content, flags=re.DOTALL) before the single-line comment removal.
